content.short: Cardano Robots is a collectible art project created on Cardano Blockchain as NFT with total supply 2,590 unique pieces.
content.description:
Cardano Robots is a collectible art project. Each piece you can buy as NFT. Our art will be minted as a native token on Cardano blockchain. Cardano Robots features 2,590 unique pieces. We have 5 Editions. Largest Edition is Friends: These robots are friendly, have a lot of friends and a lot of activities. Smallest edition of Cardano Robot is Gold Edition: They are rich and influential robots that occur in small quantities. They are characterized by gold necklaces, a cigar, a crown and a bag full of cardano ​coins.

The sale has been launched at 12th December 2021 and still is open. This sale is open for everyone. If you buy more than 30 pcs, then you get a 10% discount and If you buy more than 50 pcs, then you get a 15% discount.
